about: Sourced corrections to src/lib/coverage-details.server.ts applied by scripts/expand-coverage.ts. Each names its evidence: SEC submissions for the CIK, or the company's own 8-K exhibit (accession and the words quoted from it). A description of another entity or of a former name is replaced by the generator's SEC-built fallback sentence, never by written text; a website no filing states is removed rather than replaced. A correction whose old value no longer matches is reported and not applied.
